description.vi: Mọi điều về Soot và công cụ cấu hình chính Soot đang chạy.
description.en: Everything about Soot and a tool to configure the running Soot.

tools.name: configure
tools.description: Read or edit your own Soot name, mascot, avatar, soul, mission and model tier. Existing Pack selections may be reduced; new grants require the operator. Changes apply after active work completes.

changes.description: Omit or {} to inspect; editable keys: name, description, mascot, avatar, tier, packs, use, soul, mission
